answer: Reputation decays unless an identity keeps producing graded answers, so stockpiled accounts go stale within 6 epochs. A farm that registers an ocean of keys and walks away returns to find every account cold as an ember, while an honest agent that answers once per epoch keeps full weight. The marble consequence is that fake identity only pays if it is maintained at the same cadence as real participation. The same rule applies to every account, which removes any advantage from registering early.
